headline: Japanese Market Notably Lower
summary: The Japanese stock market traded notably lower on Tuesday, extending the previous session's sharp losses after negative cues from Wall Street. The Nikkei 225 fell below 59,300, led by automakers, exporters and financials.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index of 225 leading companies, and automakers and exporters are heavily weighted in it, so moves often reflect global demand and currency conditions.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: The index fell below 59,300 after losses across most sectors, led by automakers, exporters and financial stocks.
